title: Outgrow Supabase: in-cluster Postgres, Spot run pods, drop Filestore (pl-6076)
rationale: Postgres-to-Postgres keeps the drizzle journal and every migration untouched; SQLite has no export tooling and the events corpus is an RL asset; Cloud SQL needs VPC setup for similar cost. Only run pods are retry-safe, so Spot applies to them alone. Filestore has a 1TiB minimum with no smaller RWX tier.

title: Removed the Filestore repo cache; blobless partial clone is the default init path
rationale: Basic HDD has a 1 TiB minimum with no smaller RWX tier, so the cache cost ~$200/mo against a 2.9 GB repo. warren-3b44's partial clone needs no shared storage; the mirror cache stays opt-in for single-node RWO clusters (warren-554f). Do not re-provision Filestore for this.

title: Supabase decommissioned same day as the in-cluster Postgres cutover
rationale: Pro plan has no pause option, so the choice was keep-running or delete. Evidence for deleting: zero pooler client connections after the 15:37Z cutover dump, live warren serving 30+ post-cutover runs from postgres.warren.svc, Supabase held only public+drizzle (no storage objects, auth users, or edge functions), and the cutover dump md5 matched the bucket copy. The 7-day rollback window bought nothing a dump restore cannot.

description: K8s Spot preemption is classified as oom_killed/provider_error: when a Spot node goes NotReady and is deleted, every run pod on it exits 137, pod-watcher maps 137 to oom_killed, reap emits provider_error, and provider-retry skips (verdict unknown) — no infra-lost retry fires. Seen 2026-09-03 21:32Z killing warren-ea4e and warren-935a mid-run (~$0.25 lost, two hand re-dispatches).
resolution: Re-dispatch the seed from main; check kubectl get events -A for NodeNotReady/TaintManagerEviction/DeletingNode before blaming the model or the memory limit. Fix tracked in warren-a757 (read containerStatuses terminated.reason; classify node loss as sandbox_run_lost).

name: run-pod-memory-and-spot-capacity
description: Per-project run-pod memory lives in .warren/config.yaml resources.requests/limits.memoryMiB (resolveMemoryMiB in src/runtime/k8s/pod-resources.ts prefers it over WARREN_K8S_MEMORY_*_MIB). The warren project runs at 8192 MiB since 2026-09-03 because bun run check:all builds the Vite UI and runs the UI test suite and OOM-killed three of four UI runs at the 4 GiB cluster default. Autopilot NAP then picks e2-highmem-4 Spot nodes (2 pods each, 3920m CPU allocatable) and the us-west1 E2_CPUS quota (24) caps the fleet at two Spot nodes — effective concurrency 4 (warren-c55c).
